{{Short description|Serbian-American physicist}}
{{About||basketball player|Marko Jarić}}

'''Marko V. Jarić''' (Марко Вукобрат Јарић; March 17, 1952 in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]] – October 25, 1997 in [[College Station, Texas]]) was a [[Serbian Americans|Serbian-American]] physicist. He served as visiting professor at  [[Montana State University]] and [[Harvard University]], and full professor at [[Texas A&M University]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eserbia.org/people/science/215-marko-v-jaric|title=Marko V. Jaric|publisher=Serbica Americana|accessdate=May 20, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author1=Agnolet, Glenn|author2=Saslow, Wayne|author3=Belic, Milivoj|author4=Birman, Joseph|author5=Moss, Simon|title=Obituary: Marko Vukobrat Jarić|journal=Physics Today|date=June 1998|volume=51|issue=6|pages=91–92|url=http://www.physicstoday.org/resource/1/phtoad/v51/i6/p91_s1?bypassSSO=1|archive-url=https://archive.today/20131008004528/http://www.physicstoday.org/resource/1/phtoad/v51/i6/p91_s1?bypassSSO=1|url-status=dead|archive-date=2013-10-08|doi=10.1063/1.882287|bibcode=1998PhT....51f..91A|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

Jarić was a leading researcher in the field of Quasi-Crystals authoring and editing four influential books. An annual award was established in his name, known as the "Serbian Nobel Prize," for excellence in physics by a Serbian born physicist.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130616140008/http://www.serbianunity.com/serbianunitycongress/our-work/culture-and-society-/155-marko-jaric-award-program-2002|title=Serbian Unity Congress}}</ref><ref>[https://www.buffalo.edu/news/releases/2012/08/13634.html University at Buffalo Awardee]</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=University at Buffalo |work=States News Service |date=August 31, 2012 |url=https://www.highbeam.com/doc/1G1-301255354.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171026002601/https://www.highbeam.com/doc/1G1-301255354.html |archive-date=October 26, 2017 |via=[[HighBeam Research]] |url-access=subscription |url-status=usurped}}</ref><ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130616140043/http://www.physics.fsu.edu/news/2009/SerbiaLaudsDobrosavljevic/|title=Florida State Awardee}}</ref><ref>[https://www.fondacijajaric.rs/ The Foundation "Prof. Marko V. Jarić]</ref>
